scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:terminal && npm run build:monaco
scripts.build:renderer: tsc -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json && shx cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/styles.css src/renderer/browser.html dist/renderer/
scripts.build:terminal: esbuild src/renderer/terminal-renderer.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/terminal-bundle.js --platform=browser && shx cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css src/renderer/terminal.html dist/renderer/
scripts.build:monaco: shx cp src/renderer/monaco.html dist/renderer/ && shx cp -r node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs dist/renderer/monaco
